 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioners, through the medium of present petition, have sought a direction upon respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to submit their land acquisition case to the court of learned Principal District Judge,
Jammu (Reference Court) for determination of amount of compensation in respect of the land of the petitioners which has been acquired for construction of 135 feet wide composite bundh on the Indo Pak Border at Village Gulabgarh, Tehsil Suchetgarh, District Jammu.

2. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the land belonging to the petitioners was acquired by the respondents and in terms of final award dated 22.12.2015 passed by the Collector, compensation at the rate of Rs. 78,800/- per kanal along with Jabrana @ 15% per annum was assessed in favour of the land owners.

It has been further submitted that on 22.06.2024,
the petitioners received the assessed compensation in respect of their land under protest and they also filed Form No. 20-A before the respondent No. 3, the Collector.
However, the said respondent has not made any reference in terms of Section 18 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act to the Principal District Judge, Jammu for determination of compensation.
Mr. Vishal Sharma, learned DSGI waives notice on behalf of respondent No. 1.

Ms. Nazia Fazal,
Advocate appearing vice Ms. Monika Kohli, learned Senior AAG waives notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 2 and 3.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners would feel satisfied in case a direction is issued to respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to consider their application for reference to the Principal District Judge, Jammu in terms of Section 18 of the State Land Acquisition Act,
expeditiously within some specified time.
6. Learned counsel for respondent No. 1 has submitted that the application of the petitioners is barred by time.

7. Without going into merits of the rival contentions of the parties, this petition can be disposed of at this stage by extending appropriate directions to respondent Nos. 2 and 3.
8.

Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to decide the application made by the petitioners for reference to the learned Principal District Judge,
Jammu under Section 18 of the State Land Acquisition Act in accordance with the law, most expeditiously, preferably within a period of one month from the date a certified copy of this order is made available to the said respondents.
9. Disposed of.
(SANJAY DHAR) JUDGE Jammu 08.04.2025
Whether the order is speaking: Yes/No.

Whether the order is reportable: Yes/No.
